description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer
 

**RunLoyal · Full\\-time · Coimbatore, India** 




  





 About RunLoyal
 


 RunLoyal is a fast\\-growing vertical SaaS and payments company headquartered in Atlanta, GA, building the operating system for the pet care industry — boarding, daycare, grooming, training, and dog parks. Our platform runs the daily operations of hundreds of real businesses, and our 2026 focus is scaling the product engine behind an expanding enterprise segment.
 




  






 We're hiring a Senior Full Stack Engineer to lead our most strategic builds.
 




  





 The Role
 


 This is not a sprint\\-pool position. You'll operate the way
 
**forward\\-deployed engineers** 

 do — dropped into a problem space and trusted to drive it from ambiguity to shipped. You'll be handed a strategic initiative (a new AI product build, a greenfield module, a flagship platform project), gather context directly from stakeholders and customers, set the technical direction, structure the work, and deliver with teammates — leading from the front.
 




  






 You'll report to the Head of Engineering and work embedded with the Head of Product on new initiatives, in an independent lane with direct access to leadership. We operate AI\\-native: our newest product surfaces are being designed and built with agentic AI workflows at the core, and you'll help define how AI\\-native engineering works here — not just follow a playbook.
 




  






 Honest framing: we're a fast\\-moving, founder\\-driven team in transition toward modern SaaS delivery practice. You'll have real autonomy and real accountability in equal measure. If you need a fully paved road, this isn't your role. If you've shipped meaningful things through ambiguity before — and enjoyed it — read on.
 




  





 What You'll Own
 

 1\\. Strategic build projects — end\\-to\\-end
 


 Own flagship initiatives from first principles to production: architecture, delivery plan, execution with teammates, release, and post\\-release iteration. You're accountable for the outcome, not just the code — which means demoing early, cutting scope intelligently, and shipping working software on a rhythm.
 




  





 2\\. Technical leadership from the front
 


 Set the technical direction on your projects and bring teammates along through visible working practice — pairing, reviewing, and raising the bar rather than issuing instructions. Mentor by doing. Contribute to system design and architecture decisions across the platform, and push our engineering practices forward.
 




  





 3\\. AI\\-augmented delivery — our default operating mode
 


 Independently architect and deliver full projects using AI\\-augmented workflows: agentic coding (Claude Code or equivalent), spec\\-driven development, AI\\-led test generation, and structured context management. This is how the role works day\\-to\\-day, not an accelerator bolted on. You'll co\\-author our internal AI engineering playbooks and raise the bar for how the whole team builds.
 




  





 4\\. Core engineering
 


 Design and ship scalable Spring Boot microservices, RESTful APIs, and responsive frontends in Angular or React. Write efficient SQL, optimize JVM performance, own production issues on your surfaces end\\-to\\-end, and leave the codebase better documented than you found it.
 




  





 Leadership \\& Agency — what we'll evaluate hardest
 
* **You lead from the front.** 

 You've set direction on projects and carried teammates with you — through working code and clear communication, not title or authority
* **High agency.** 

 You identify what's blocking the outcome and remove it yourself — whether it's code, process, or a conversation someone needs to have
* **Strong stakeholder muscle.** 

 You communicate clearly upward and outward — written updates, proactive demos, and comfort presenting to leadership and customers directly
* **Async\\-native.** 

 You work effectively across time zones with documentation and over\\-communication as defaults, not afterthoughts
* **Calm ownership under ambiguity.** 

 Handed a loosely defined problem, you structure it, sequence it, and start shipping



  





 What You Bring
 

**Must have** 




  




* Significant professional software development experience with real ownership scar tissue — you've led projects, not just tickets. We care about evidence, not years
* Strong hands\\-on Java and Spring Boot; solid microservices architecture and REST API design
* Frontend experience with Angular or React
* Experience with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) and SQL optimization; JVM fundamentals and backend performance
* **AI\\-native engineering (hard requirement).** 

 You already deliver work through AI\\-augmented workflows — agentic coding tools, prompt/context engineering, AI\\-driven testing — and can demonstrate the most complex thing you've shipped this way
* Product\\-company experience: you've built for end users with daily stakes, and you think in outcomes
* Strong debugging, analytical, and problem\\-solving skills; unit testing and code coverage discipline
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience



  





**Nice to have** 




  




* Forward\\-deployed, consulting, or founding\\-engineer experience — dropped into a customer or problem space and shipped
* AWS (EC2, ECS), Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Redis or similar caching
* SaaS or multi\\-tenant systems; Golang exposure
* DevOps and security best practices awareness



  





 What You'll Gain
 
* Ownership of flagship builds on a live, growing SaaS platform — your projects, your outcomes, visible to the whole company
* Direct working partnership with the Head of Product and Head of Engineering
* A defining role in how AI\\-native engineering is practiced at a product company that takes it seriously
* Fast growth in a high\\-velocity startup with a clear product vision



  





 Our Values
 

**Kindness** 

 — We assume positive intent, celebrate each other, and call out bad acting when we see it.
 




  





**Trust** 

 — We are authentic, humble, and empathetic. In a world full of change, trust is non\\-negotiable.
 




  





**Fearlessness** 

 — We are bold, honest, and direct. Mistakes are learning opportunities, not failures.
 




  





**Discourse, Not Dissonance** 

 — The best ideas win. Data drives decisions, and constructive challenges are always welcome.
 




  





**Understanding, Not Consensus** 

 — We stand firm in informed convictions. We disagree healthily but commit once a decision is made.
 




  





**Ownership** 

 — We take initiative, solve problems, and hold ourselves accountable for our impact.
 




  





**Curiosity** 

 — We love learning and grow continuously with the industry.
 




  






 One more thing: a genuine love for pets goes a long way here.
 




  





 How to Apply
 


 Send the following — applications without all three will not be reviewed:
 




  




1. **Your project story.** 

 One page or less: a project you led end\\-to\\-end through significant ambiguity — what you shipped, how you led the team, and what measurably changed. Specifics over adjectives.
2. **Your AI workflow.** 

 A short description of how AI is embedded in your actual engineering workflow today — tools, techniques, and the most complex thing you've shipped with it.
3. **Your resume.**

description:
We are looking for an experienced, hands\\-on 
 
**Shopify Developer** 

  with strong core knowledge of the Shopify ecosystem. We need someone who can go beyond basic theme customization and app installation and can 
 
**build, modify, integrate, troubleshoot, and optimize Shopify stores end\\-to\\-end** 

 .

 .

 .

**Shopify Functions and Checkout Extensibility** 

  where required.

 .

 .

**Liquid/theme development, metafields/metaobjects, Shopify Functions, APIs, webhooks, a custom app, an external service, or a combination of these**

* Difficult Shopify problems you solved

* Theme architecture and Liquid work
* Technical decisions and trade\\-offs you made

**demonstrated Shopify engineering ability and problem\\-solving skills than certificates or the number of Shopify projects listed on a resume** 

 .
 




 Ideal Candidate
 


 A developer who can own Shopify technically — someone we can give a business requirement to and trust them to

 .

title: Senior AI/ML Engineer — Hands-on AI Lead
description:
**Company:** 
 CYURÆ
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram, Haryana

 Full\\-time, On\\-site
 



**Experience:** 
 5\\+ years
 



**Reports to:** 
 CTO / Founding Team
 


 About CYURÆ
 
 CYURÆ is building an AI\\-powered fashion intelligence platform focused on personalised styling, visual understanding, recommendation systems and premium digital fashion experiences. We need a senior, hands\\-on AI professional who can lead model development, guide our existing AI Engineer and take AI systems from experimentation to production.
 


 About the Role
 
 We are hiring a
 **Senior AI/ML Engineer with 5\\+ years of practical experience** 
 in AI, machine learning and deep learning. You will own the design, fine\\-tuning, evaluation, deployment and continuous improvement of CYURÆ’s AI systems.
 



 This is not a prompt\\-engineering\\-only role. You should understand the complete AI lifecycle:
 



**Problem definition → data preparation → model selection → fine\\-tuning → evaluation → deployment → monitoring → improvement** 




**You will work closely with the CTO, product team, fashion experts, backend developers, mobile developers and UI/UX designers.** 



 Key ResponsibilitiesAI Architecture and Technical Ownership
 * Design and own CYURÆ’s AI and machine\\-learning architecture.
* Convert product requirements into AI workflows, model pipelines, APIs and measurable evaluation criteria.
* Decide when to use hosted models, open\\-source models, fine\\-tuned models, recommendation algorithms, retrieval systems or deterministic rules.
* Build model\\-agnostic services so models and providers can be replaced without major application changes.
* Review AI code, experiments and model performance.
* Mentor the existing AI Engineer and support future AI hiring.


 Model Fine\\-Tuning and Customisation
 * Fine\\-tune language, vision, multimodal and embedding models for CYURÆ\\-specific use cases.
* Build and maintain training, validation, test and human\\-reviewed evaluation datasets.
* Work with LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, adapter tuning, quantisation and knowledge distillation.
* Handle dataset cleaning, deduplication, annotation, augmentation, class balancing and quality checks.
* Track model versions, checkpoints, training parameters and experiment results.
* Reduce hallucination, inconsistency and bias using improved data, validation and guardrails.
* Optimise models for accuracy, latency, GPU memory, throughput and cost.


 Multimodal AI and Computer Vision
 * Build systems combining text, images and structured user or product data.
* Develop image classification, visual embeddings, semantic image search, garment attribute extraction, image similarity, object detection, segmentation, colour extraction and visual tagging.
* Evaluate and use CLIP, SigLIP, ViT, vision transformers and vision\\-language models.
* Build confidence scoring, fallback logic and human\\-review flows for low\\-confidence predictions.
* Compare third\\-party vision APIs with self\\-hosted or fine\\-tuned models based on quality, privacy, latency and cost.


 Recommendation and Personalisation
 * Design personalised recommendation, ranking and reranking systems.
* Build user, style, item and interaction representations using embeddings and structured features.
* Develop candidate generation, filtering, compatibility scoring, ranking, diversity and feedback\\-learning logic.
* Handle cold\\-start users, new products, sparse data and changing preferences.
* Track precision, recall, NDCG, acceptance rate, diversity and coverage.
* Work with fashion experts to convert qualitative judgement into structured labels and evaluation criteria.


 LLM, RAG and Structured Workflows
 * Build reliable LLM and multimodal workflows using commercial and open\\-source models.
* Develop retrieval\\-augmented generation using embeddings, vector search, metadata filters and hybrid retrieval.
* Implement structured outputs using JSON schemas, tool calling, validators, retries, confidence thresholds and fallback models.
* Version prompts, model configurations and evaluation datasets.
* Create automated and human\\-reviewed evaluation suites to prevent regressions.
* Keep model\\-generated outputs separate from deterministic product and business logic.


 Production AI Engineering and MLOps
 * Convert notebooks and proofs of concept into maintainable production services.
* Build model\\-serving APIs using Python and FastAPI.
* Containerise AI services with Docker and deploy them on AWS.
* Work with services such as Bedrock, SageMaker, ECS/EKS, S3, SQS, CloudWatch, PostgreSQL and Redis.
* Use Hugging Face, vLLM, TGI, Triton or equivalent inference frameworks.
* Build model and prompt versioning, rollback, monitoring and cost\\-tracking systems.
* Implement logging, tracing, latency monitoring, error handling, retries and asynchronous processing.
* Optimise inference through batching, caching, quantisation and model routing.
* Maintain clean code, tests, documentation and deployment runbooks.


 Evaluation, Security and Privacy
 * Define quality, latency, safety, reliability and cost thresholds before releasing models.
* Build test cases for standard, edge, multilingual, low\\-quality and adversarial inputs.
* Monitor model drift, data drift, quality degradation and inference costs.
* Protect user images, profile data and preferences during training and inference.
* Prevent prompt injection, data leakage, cross\\-user exposure and unauthorised retrieval.
* Maintain traceability for model version, prompt version, input source, output, latency and cost.
* Follow privacy\\-by\\-design, least\\-privilege and data\\-minimisation principles.


 Required Qualifications
 * 5\\+ years of professional experience in AI, ML, deep learning or applied data science.
* Strong production\\-level Python skills.
* Advanced practical experience with PyTorch and Hugging Face.
* Proven experience fine\\-tuning open\\-source language, vision, embedding or multimodal models.
* Hands\\-on knowledge of LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, quantisation or similar techniques.
* Experience building repeatable training, validation and evaluation pipelines.
* Strong understanding of transformers, embeddings, attention mechanisms and deep\\-learning fundamentals.
* Experience in at least two areas: LLMs, computer vision, multimodal AI, recommendation systems, personalisation or semantic search.
* Experience deploying AI systems into production and performing model evaluation and error analysis.
* Experience with FastAPI or another Python API framework.
* Working knowledge of PostgreSQL, Redis and vector search tools such as pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate, Milvus or OpenSearch.
* Experience with Docker, CI/CD, Git and cloud infrastructure.
* Experience with AWS or an equivalent cloud platform.
* Ability to mentor engineers, review code and make architecture decisions.
* Comfortable working full\\-time from our Gurugram office.


 Preferred Qualifications
 * Experience in fashion\\-tech, retail, e\\-commerce or consumer applications.
* Experience building recommendation, ranking or visual\\-search systems at scale.
* Knowledge of CLIP, SigLIP, ViT, segmentation models, diffusion models or multimodal foundation models.
* Experience with MLflow, Weights \\& Biases, DVC or similar tools.

 This Role Is Not Suitable For
 * Candidates whose experience is limited to prompt writing or third\\-party AI API integration.
* Candidates with only coursework, certifications or notebook\\-level projects and no production deployment.
* Candidates unable to explain the dataset, architecture, metrics and business outcome of their AI projects.
* Candidates seeking only a management role without hands\\-on development.


 What Success Looks Like
 
 During the first three to six months, you should be able to:
 


* Review and improve the current AI architecture.
* Establish model, prompt, dataset and evaluation versioning.
* Define measurable baselines for quality, latency, reliability and cost.
* Complete at least one relevant model fine\\-tuning or adaptation project.

 What We Offer

 How to Apply
 
 Send your CV, LinkedIn profile, GitHub/GitLab profile and relevant project links to
 **contact@cyurae.com** 
 .
 


* Please include your current location, current and expected compensation, notice period, confirmation that you can work on\\-site in Gurugram, and a short description of one model you fine\\-tuned—including the base model, dataset, method, evaluation metric and production result.
